stars_source: GitHub search API via GitHub MCP (as ayushozha)
framework: Astro 7 (static, no adapter; AGENTS.md says 'Output Mode: Static (SSG)'), npm workspaces (packages/create-accessible-astro-starter CLI)
build_claude: FAIL_ENV: Node 24.22.1 / npm 11.19.1 (engines: node >=24.19.0, npm >=11.17.0; .nvmrc v24.19.0). npm ci succeeded. astro build rendered every route up to /index.html, then failed: 'TypeError: fetch failed ... getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND jsonplaceholder.typicode.com'. The proxy returns 403 for that host. src/components/FeaturedPosts.astro fetches https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts unconditionally at build time, and the blog pages and launcher fetch BLOG_API_URL (default is the same host). Log: logs/incluud_accessible-astro-starter.build.log
compat_notes: Root 'npm run build' is 'astro build' of the site into root dist/. The CLI workspace (packages/create-accessible-astro-starter) builds only through 'build:cli' into its own packages/.../dist, so the deployed output is the site, not the CLI. The build needs outbound HTTPS to jsonplaceholder.typicode.com (a third-party placeholder API). The contact form posts to /thank-you (method=post); a static host will not accept a POST to a static page, so this needs checking or a form service. strict-allow-scripts=true in .npmrc with an allowScripts allowlist. No Staticfile needed: astro.config sets no outDir, so the build writes to Astro's default dist (verified in the build), which is the folder node_static serves.
policy: No CONTRIBUTING or PR template; the README Contributing section welcomes PRs. incluud/.github has only CODE_OF_CONDUCT, FUNDING and a profile. AGENTS.md is a project overview for agents with no contribution restrictions. Commits follow conventional style (git-cliff). No existing Wasmer or host-button PR.
why: Popular static SSG starter (per AGENTS.md) that has no deploy section; the README 'Getting started' table says npm run build outputs to ./dist/.
patch: patches/incluud_accessible-astro-starter.patch (staged; adds a '## Deploy' section after Getting started; applies to base; no PR body until the build is verified)
detection_verified: pending Codex browser check; also needs an external build with network access to jsonplaceholder.typicode.com
reason: The build is blocked here by sandbox egress (jsonplaceholder.typicode.com is fetched at build time), so I could not run the smoke test. It needs a build with network access (e.g. Codex) before READY.
